test_title: PYST 23: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: If A - B means that A is the father of B, A + B means that A is the mother of B, A × B means that A is the brother of B then which of the following expression shows that Q is the brother of P?
solution:
The symbols and their meanings in the family tree are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c74c3fc18ae32322dfce40504ba78d4638a08e810525a49f9bbfc57971f0d3dc.png] 

Given statements and their meaning are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e9bb00cb7b0a38f6a2217d04cef52ba9205c733dd3433669ff059dc545b4cd0.png] 

 

According to the given statement the family tree will be:

1) P × Q - R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c49df0feffa2253d974ab3e7651e24e1417f849720f66c96eaf090b65c99afa8.png] 

__
 
• Therefore,** Q is the brother of P.**

2) P × Q + R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0184899d6a8ca5c36544bb8c956834ae9966bb99cede5e49c56fe6cf04b9ef53.png] 

 
• Therefore, Q is the sister of P.

3) R + P × Q

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b078f95279b068909c339b28fb25f86baf48c1bad6005577e102abfaf033e43.png] 

 
• Therefore, Q is the brother/sister of P.

4) Q - P - R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17b17f7bfb6a119fba4f933c57305525ac8e8a8c9fed518250b65b15e22252bf.png] 

 
• Therefore, Q is the father of P.

Thus, the expression **P × Q - R** shows that Q is the brother of P.

Hence, the correct answer is '**option 1**__'.
